job.job_title: Gen AI/ LLM Engineer with Node.js or Java
job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

As part of a strategic initiative on Generative AI, you will design,
build, and industrialize highvisibility GenAI solutions.
You will work closely with innovation, data, and IT teams to deliver
robust, scalable, and secure AI capabilities that integrate seamlessly
with enterprise systems



Preferred candidate profile

Strong backend engineering experience in Python, Node.js, or Java.
Proficiency with GenAI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and OpenAI API.
Handson exposure to at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or
GCP) and experience with demanding productiongrade industrial
environments.
Ability to operate effectively in large enterprise ecosystems:
structured communication, rigor, and a strong service mindset.
Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and MLOps pipelines is a strong plus.
